title: Azzurro Dream
meta_description: Find the perfect Seagrove Beach, FL vacation rental at Azzurro Dream, a luxury 8-bed, 8.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 22 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Seagrove Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS • 8 Bedrooms & 8.5 Full Baths • Sleeps 22 • Gulf Front with Private Beach • 4 Stories & 6,005 Square Feet • 6-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Private Pool & Jetted Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Direct Beach Access • Beach Chair Setup (4 Chairs and 2 Umbrella) Provided March 1st - October 31st • Elevator • Handicap Accessible Tub on 3rd floor • Deeded Beach Access • Parking for 3 Vehicles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 22) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 8) • Bedroom 1: Bunk Room with Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 4) Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 2: Bunk Room with Twin over Twin Bunk Bed (sleeps 2) Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Media Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa (sleeps 2) THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 6) • Bedroom 3: Primary Gulf Facing Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Modern Soaking Tub & Tile/Glass Shower | Private Balcony with Gulf Views • Bedroom 4: Primary Gulf Facing Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Tile/Glass Shower & Handicap Accessible Tub • Bedroom 5: Guest Suite with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower FOURTH FLOOR (Sleeps 8) • Bedroom 6: Primary Gulf Facing Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Modern Soaking Tub Tile/Glass Shower + Office Workspace (Gulf Front Shared Balcony) • Bedroom 7: Primary Gulf Facing Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Modern Soaking Tub Tile/Glass Shower (Gulf Front Shared Balcony) • Bedroom 8: Two Queen Beds (sleeps 4) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities & Tile/Glass Shower DESCRIPTION: Discover coastal elegance at ‘Azzurro Dream’, a newly constructed luxury retreat on Seagrove Beach’s renowned 30A. This remarkable 8-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom estate spans 6,000 square feet, blending refined design with panoramic Gulf views. Accommodating up to 22 guests, ‘Azzurro Dream’ offers a private boardwalk leading directly to white sands and emerald waters, complemented by a beach setup for seamless days on the shore. The ground floor welcomes you with a charming living area and two cozy guest bedrooms, each thoughtfully outfitted with bunk beds—one room featuring twin-over-twin bunks, and the other with a single twin-over-twin bunk. A queen sleeper sofa invites relaxation in the adjacent living space, opening onto a patio furnished with Adirondack chairs for quiet coastal evenings. A washer and dryer are conveniently located on this floor to keep your beachwear fresh. Ascend to the second floor—via staircase or the home’s private elevator—where the open-concept great room sets the scene for gatherings and entertainment. High ceilings and expansive windows bathe the space in natural light, while plush seating surrounds a tasteful fireplace, offering an ideal spot to unwind. The dining area, with seating for eight, invites shared meals crafted in the gourmet kitchen, which is outfitted with quartzite countertops, high-end appliances, and a four-seat breakfast bar. Step out to the spacious outdoor deck, featuring a private pool, a sitting spa, lounge chairs, and a natural gas grill, for evenings spent dining al fresco with views of the Gulf. The third and fourth floors embody the essence of relaxation, housing six additional bedrooms. Two luxurious primary suites open to a shared balcony with breathtaking Gulf views, perfect for morning coffee or sunset gazing. Two guest bedrooms share their own balcony, and two others offer comfort and privacy, including one with its own bathroom and an additional washer and dryer. A secondary living space on the third floor provides access to a generous Gulf-facing patio, creating a serene escape for both day and night. Whether it's your first or twentieth visit to the Emerald Coast, ‘Azzurro Dream’ promises an unforgettable stay. With parking for four vehicles, a six-passenger golf cart, and six adult bikes, guests can explore nearby boutiques, restaurants, and the scenic 30A bike path with ease. Embrace the luxury of coastal living and book your escape to ‘Azzurro Dream’ today. LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: • 2 Guest Rooms with Ensuite Baths • Media Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa & Separate Seating Area • Wet Bar with Sink, Ice Maker & Wine Fridge • Washer and Dryer • Access to the first floor Furnished Patio • Elevator SECOND FLOOR: • Main Living Area with Gas Fireplace & Stunning Gulf Views • Chef's dream kitchen with 6 burner Wolf stove, wine fridge, ice maker, oversized custom fridge, convection microwave & dishwasher • Spacious Island with seating for Four • Elegant Dining Table with Seating for 8 • Separate Seating Area for 6 • Half Guest Bath • Access to Gulf Front Pool Deck • Front load washer & dryer THIRD FLOOR: • Media Room with Balcony Access • Primary Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom with Private Balcony • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Queen Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Washer & Dryer FOURTH FLOOR: • Primary Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom with Office Space • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Two Queen Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Media Room GULF FRONT POOL DECK: • Gulf Front Pool & Jetted Spa • Grilling Station • 4 Loungers & Adirondack chairs • Private Beach Access CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Seagrove Proper (2 Miles) • The Big Chill (2.2 Miles) • WaterColor Publix (4 Miles) • Seaside (4 Miles) • Alys Beach (4.8 Miles) • Rosemary Beach (5 Miles)
